args.prompt:
Use case: stylized-concept. Make ONE transparent game UI illustration atlas, exactly THREE equal columns and TWO equal rows, six isolated complete objects in row-major order. No mascot, people, text, labels, lettering, numerals, visible grid, scenery or background. Each object fully inside its own equal tile with generous transparent gutters, sharing clean warm taupe outlines, rounded matte shapes, soft cream/coral/sage/lavender palette and restrained cel shading. Cute polished cozy pet-game belongings, readable at64-128px, not photographic, flat generic clipart or blurry watercolor.
Tile1: CLOSED DISCOVERY BOOK, cream padded cloth cover, rounded corners, sage spine, small embossed leaf-and-bunny-ear-shaped emblem with no face, peach bookmark ribbon, slight three-quarter view.
Tile2: the SAME discovery book OPEN, two cream blank pages with faint rounded stamp placeholders and a botanical corner sprig, sage cover, peach bookmark, no writing.
Tile3: WRAPPED GIFT, small cream rounded cube gift box tied with a thick soft coral-pink ribbon and generous bow, warm inviting miniature, slight three-quarter view.
Tile4: the SAME gift OPEN, lid lifted and tilted just above the box, coral ribbon still attached, soft pale-yellow light inside but no rays/particles beyond tile, no accessory item inside.
Tile5: tiny CREAM PAPER GIFT BAG, folded top, soft rounded handles, sage leaf seal, peach tissue peeking out, no text.
Tile6: blank embossed DISCOVERY SEAL, scalloped cream paper edge, fine warm beige contour, small sage leaves and pale yellow flower accents at sides, clear empty center, no symbols or writing.
Genuinely transparent alpha outside objects. No checkerboard, colored background panels, cast floor shadows, merged cells or extra objects.
